decision.summary: A multi-axis negative excursion centered at indices 615–625 is observed: U drops sharply and rebounds by 629, whereas E and N show delayed or incomplete recovery through the allowed context (up to 699). The lack of full return on E/N prevents confirmation of a closed temporary offset; status is uncertain. No other temporary offsets are evident within [575,699].

intervals.observation: U shows a sharp multi-sample negative excursion (≈−4 MAD) starting ~615, with smaller coincident dips in E (≈−1.5 MAD) and N (≈−1 MAD); U recovers sharply by 629, while E and N remain depressed beyond that point, indicating asymmetric return and incomplete recovery on E/N axes.
